summary: Phase 3 backend tests: 15/15 pytest cases pass. Covered: (1) POST /orders/{id}/shipping-label on a fresh order — persists shipping_provider='mock', shipping_events=[label_created], label_created_at; subsequent GET tracking returns has_label:true, provider='mock', current_status='label_created', dev_mock:true, events[0].status=='label_created'. (2) POST /orders/{id}/shipping-advance with empty body advances label_created -> picked_up, appends event, updates shipping_status, and creates a buyer notification of type='order' with title containing 'Shipping update'. (3) POST /orders/{id}/shipping-advance {to_status:'delivered'} jumps ahead; second advance on delivered order returns 400. Invalid to_status ('banana') returns 400. to_status equal to or earlier than current returns 400. (4) Non-seller/non-admin (buyer, unrelated user) receive 403 on /shipping-advance. (5) Background shipping_progress_loop: verified by backdating label_created_at 2 min into the past via direct Mongo write and polling GET /tracking — order auto-advanced to picked_up within ~50s without any client call. (6) GET /listings?sort=trending returns listings ordered by (views_count desc, likes_count desc, created_at desc) — verified with 3 seeded listings whose counters were set directly to controlled values. (7) PUT /api/listings/{id}: admin/owner can update; unrelated users get 403. (8) Regression: /auth/me carries email_verified/phone_verified/seller_status; register+login+me; /users/{id}/public omits email; verify email+phone mock flow; upload → seller/apply with id_document_file_id → admin PUT approve; /ai/listing-suggest with real base64 image returns full structured JSON (title, description, category_slug/id/name, condition, suggested_price_usd).

minor.issue: Sporadic 500 'Upload failed. Please try again.' from Emergent object storage (observed once during a run, cleared on retry). Consider adding a small retry with backoff around storage.put_object() and returning 502 (not 500) when the upstream store is unavailable so clients know it is upstream.
Requires JSON body — even though EmailSendRequest.email is Optional, sending no body returns 422. Either accept empty body (Body(None) / default request model) or make this clear to frontend.
Approval uses PUT with {status:'approved'} body — not the more RESTy POST .../approve. Ok as-is, just noting for frontend integration consistency.

action_items: Optional: add retry/backoff around Emergent storage.put_object() and return 502 on upstream storage failure so /api/upload no longer surfaces as generic 500.
server.py is now ~2376 lines — long-standing split-into-routers item still not addressed (auth, listings, seller, verify, stripe, admin, storage, ai, shipping).
critical_code_review_comments: shipping_progress_loop uses a single global 30s polling loop iterating all mock orders; fine for small volumes but will not scale — consider event-driven or worker-queue when order counts grow. Also it does not detect timezone-naive label_created_at written by tests/legacy paths without fixing them on the order (only in-memory). Minor.
advance_shipping trusts payload.to_status against a hard-coded stages list; consider centralizing the stages list in shipping_providers.py so /advance and next_stage_for_age can't drift.
Trending sort ordering is (views desc, likes desc, created_at desc) but there are no indexes on views_count/likes_count in Mongo — will full-scan as catalog grows. Add compound index.
PUT /admin/seller-applications/{app_id} accepts a raw `updates: dict` — bypasses Pydantic validation for admin surface. Prefer a typed AdminSellerReview model.
server.py still exceeds the 700-line guideline (2376 lines).

seed_data_creation: Each run creates: several admin listings ('TEST Phase3 ...' and 'TEST Trending ...' + one 'TEST EditListing ...'), several buyer orders + shipping labels (MOCK...), ephemeral registered users, a pending-then-approved seller application. Trending-test listings have views_count/likes_count set to 99999/99998/1 directly — these will appear at the top of /listings?sort=trending in the DB. Safe to leave or purge by title prefix TEST Trending/TEST Phase3/TEST EditListing.

Frontend (EditListing.jsx, ShippingTracker canAdvance button, hero carousel + flash deals redesign, trending on home page) still needs UI verification in a later iteration. rca of the issue: N/A — no product bugs found.
